Name: Long Hair Sophia for Seasonal Cute SVE
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I cobbled this together from a request on the Discord and Reddit communities today. I present a long-haired Sophia!

This is meant to work with Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]. Simply replace Sophia's Portraits and Character folders with the ones downloaded here.

All credit for the original artwork goes to Poltergeister, I just added extensions lol
